Synopsis:
Default dialogue for Hydrangea, one of the hag support group players can meet in the Lower city. The hag support group is made up of people who have survived an encouter with a hag, and who have banded together to try to research hags, but also to be there for one another. However, one of their group (the dragonborn), is secretly a redcap and is toying with their minds. The redcap has also, if Mayrina is present, hexed her and turned her into a sheep. If Mayrina isn't present, the redcap has enchanted a doll that is terrifying the group.This dialogue covers a number of states such as 1) Mayrina is present and has been hexed 2) player cured her 3) player has saved Hydrangea and the others from a redcap 4) the hag is dead and Hydrangea rewards them (if no other npc is present) 5) if mayrina isn't present, a doll is terrorising them and she's trying to find it

A redcap in hag disguise has been planted among the hag survivors as a spy. He sent a bewitched doll that taunts and scares the others — if Mayrina is present the doll was used to hex her into a sheep; if she isn’t, it merely pops up to torment the survivors. The spy is cold, accusatory, and tries to deflect blame onto the player to hide his role in the doll’s mischief. The narrator’s note that he looks like one of the hags but “smells of blood and moss” hints that his disguise is imperfect. The player has arrived either to investigate or to help Mayrina and is being watched and questioned by this suspicious spy.

He’d been disguised among the hag survivors and had secretly planted a voodoo doll to hex or torment them (turning Mayrina into a sheep if she was present, or otherwise to pop up and frighten the hags). The small group are hag victims who banded together to research and resist Auntie Ethel; they react with shock, relief, and suspicion, hoping their tormentor may be gone.
